general.title: General
general.description: App-wide behavior — what opens on launch, language, and desktop integration.

desktopIntegration.title: Desktop integration
desktopIntegration.description: Stored here and applied by the desktop app. No effect in the browser preview.

autoUpdate.title: Automatically check for updates
autoUpdate.description: Show a quiet notice in the main window when a new version is available.

whatsNewDialog.title: Show the "what's new" notice after updates
whatsNewDialog.description: After an update, show a small dialog once summarizing where to find what changed.

crashPrompt.title: Ask to send a report after a crash
crashPrompt.description: If ReadAware crashes, offer to send a diagnostics report on the next launch. Nothing is ever sent without your confirmation.

appearance.title: Appearance
appearance.description: How the app itself looks — independent of the book page color in Reading.

theme.title: Theme
theme.description: System follows your operating system's light or dark setting.

contentType.title: Content typography
contentType.description: How chat replies, notes, and plugin views are set. App controls keep their own size.

follow.title: Follow the reading settings
follow.description: Use the font and line spacing you picked for books, scaled down for conversation.

contentType.previewAnswer: That the reform began as improvisation — a series of local experiments nobody had authorised, kept alive because they worked.

reduceMotion.title: Reduce motion
reduceMotion.description: Turn off transitions and animation flourishes across the app.

reading.title: Reading
reading.description: How books render on the page. Changes apply live to the reader.
reading.previewText: History, Stephen said, is a nightmare from which I am trying to awake.
reading.previewTextSecondary: Think you're escaping and run into yourself. Longest way round is the shortest way home.

pageColor.title: Page Color
pageColor.description: The book's paper. Auto follows the app theme; the others are fixed.

pageTurn.title: Page Turning
pageTurn.description: How taps and buttons turn pages. Saved on this device and used for every book.

volumeKeys.title: Turn pages with volume keys
volumeKeys.description: While a book is open, the volume keys turn pages instead of changing the volume. They change the volume as usual while you type.

shortcuts.title: Shortcuts

categoryDescriptions.selection: Active while text is selected in the reader.
categoryDescriptions.plugins: Assign keys to commands contributed by plugins.

actions.zoom-lock: Lock zoomed view for page turns (PDF & comics)

ai.title: AI
ai.description: Bring your own model key, then choose what the assistant can do and what it may see.

features.title: Features
features.description: Reader assistance, switched on per capability as each one ships.

explainSelection.label: Explain selection
explainSelection.description: Unpack a highlighted passage in plain language.

defineTerm.label: Define term
defineTerm.description: Define a selected word or phrase in the book chat.

translate.label: Translate
translate.description: Translate a selection into your interface language.

summarizeChapter.label: Summarize chapter
summarizeChapter.description: Condense the current chapter into key points.

askConversation.label: Conversational Q&A
askConversation.description: Ask follow-up questions grounded in the book and your notes.

followStreaming.title: Follow streaming replies
followStreaming.description: Scroll along as the reply streams in. Off keeps the view anchored where the reply begins.

storedMemory.title: Stored memory
storedMemory.description: Review or erase everything ReadAware has remembered about you.

privacy.title: Privacy

sendHighlightedText.title: Send highlighted text
sendHighlightedText.description: Include the passage you selected in the request.

sendSurroundingContext.title: Send surrounding context
sendSurroundingContext.description: Include nearby paragraphs so answers stay grounded in the text.

readaware.description: Built-in models, no API key of your own — usage is metered monthly in credits against your plan.
readaware.notConnected: Connect your account in Data & Sync first — the subscription signs in with it.
readaware.requiresPaid: Bundled AI needs a Pro or Max plan; the Free plan uses your own key.

customBaseUrl.label: Custom Base URL

customApi.label: API format

customMaxOutputTokens.label: Maximum output tokens
customMaxOutputTokens.helper: Optional. Leave empty to let the provider choose its own limit.

apiKey.label: API Key
apiKey.helper: Your API key is encrypted and stored only on this device. It is never sent to ReadAware's servers.

aiConfig.testEmptyMessage: Test failed: Empty response from AI provider.

byok.title: About BYOK (Bring Your Own Key)
byok.body: ReadAware uses your key to call the selected provider. The key is encrypted and stored only on this device; provider usage charges still apply.

aiConfig.smartModelHelper: Chat, onboarding, and cross-book synthesis — the slower, more capable tier.
aiConfig.fastModelHelper: Dictionary, memory, and summaries — the cheaper, faster tier.

aiConfig.thinkingHelper: Used by both Smart and Fast tasks. Higher levels think longer before answering; models without thinking support ignore this.

dataSync.title: Data & Sync
dataSync.description: ReadAware is local-first: your data lives on this device. Sync is an encrypted relay, not a source of truth.

account.title: Account
account.description: Connect an account to sync your encrypted event log across devices.

e2e.title: End-to-end encryption
e2e.description: Synced data is encrypted on-device. Manage your passphrase and devices here.

dataLocation.title: Data location
dataLocation.descTauri: Stored in the ReadAware application data folder on this device.
dataLocation.descWeb: The data directory is available in the desktop app.
dataLocation.loadFailed: Could not read the data directory.
dataLocation.revealFailed: Could not reveal the data directory.

backup.title: Backup & export
backup.description: Save and restore complete encrypted backups.

contextBundles.title: Context bundles
contextBundles.description: Versioned, reproducible context artifacts for external agents: the reader profile, declared reading intentions, one book's memory behind the current spoiler boundary, or one conversation's stored summary. Each capture publishes an immutable version to your synced event log; saving writes a JSON file you choose.
contextBundles.descWeb: Context bundles are available in the desktop app.
contextBundles.noScope: Import a book or start a conversation to use this recipe.
contextBundles.captureDescription: Reads the current sources and publishes a new version only when the content changed.
contextBundles.captureFailed: Could not capture the context bundle.
contextBundles.historyDescription: Newest first. Saving writes the exact published artifact.
contextBundles.saveFailed: Could not save the context bundle.

deleteAccount.title: Delete this account?
deleteAccount.body: This permanently deletes your sync account and every synced copy of your data on the server — the encrypted event log and all uploaded book files. Other devices signed in to this account stop syncing.
deleteAccount.billingNote: Your subscription is canceled along with the account; there are no further charges.
deleteAccount.localNote: Books, notes, and reading history on this device are not affected.
deleteAccount.done: Your account and its synced data were deleted.
deleteAccount.failed: Could not delete the account. Check your connection and try again.

syncStatus.signedOut: Signed out — sign in again to resume syncing

connect.sent: Check your inbox — then paste the sign-in link or token below.
connect.passphraseHint: Encrypts your data before it leaves this device. The first device sets it; every other device must enter the same one. It cannot be recovered — if you forget it, synced data is unreadable.
connect.wrongPassphrase: That passphrase doesn't match this account.
connect.failed: Could not connect. Check the link and try again.
connect.oauthStarted: Finish signing in in the browser, then paste the token it shows below.
connect.tokenInvalid: That sign-in link or token didn't work — it may have expired or already have been used. Request a new one.
connect.tokenRetry: We couldn't verify this token right now. Check your connection and try again — the token has been kept below.
connect.freshAccount: This account has no encryption passphrase yet — this device will set it. Make sure this is your account: once you connect, this device's library syncs to it.

connected.disconnectBody: This device keeps all its data and stops syncing. Reconnect anytime with the same passphrase.

transport.description: Sync through your own server — provided by the {{plugin}} plugin.
transport.checkFailed: Could not reach the server. Check the plugin's settings, then try again.
transport.settingsHint: The server address and credentials are set in the plugin's settings.
transport.freshRemote: This server holds no synced data yet — this device will set its encryption passphrase.
transport.existingRemote: This server already holds encrypted data. Enter the same passphrase that created it.
transport.wrongPassphrase: That passphrase doesn't match this server's data.
transport.manualHint: Syncs only when you press Sync now
transport.pluginUnavailable: Connected through the {{plugin}} plugin, which is disabled or missing. Disconnect to sync another way.
transport.otherBackend: Sync is already connected to another backend. Disconnect it in Data & Sync first.

billing.failed: Couldn't open the billing page. Try again.

progress.bootstrap: Restoring the library from the account snapshot…
progress.verifying: Checking what the server already has… {{count}} confirmed
progress.backfillRemaining: History still filling in: {{count}} changes to go

deleteAll.title: Delete all data
deleteAll.description: Erase everything on this device — books, annotations, reading history, settings, and sync credentials. A synced account's copy on other devices is not touched.
deleteAll.dialogBody: This erases every book, annotation, memory, conversation, and setting on this device, and cannot be undone. Data already synced to other devices stays on those devices.
deleteAll.failed: Couldn't delete all data. Nothing may have been removed — try again.

books.title: Book files
books.rejectedQuota: Cloud storage is full — upgrade your plan for more space, or remove some books.
books.rejected: The sync server declined this file. Details are in the app log.
books.awaitingOtherDevice: Waiting for the device that holds the file
books.quotaFull: Cloud storage is full — further books stay on this device until space frees up or the plan grows.
books.rejectedTooLarge: This file is over your plan's per-book size limit — upgrading raises it.

exportDialog.title: Export a backup
exportDialog.fullDescription: Books, annotations, conversations, memory, settings, plugins and credentials, saved with password encryption.
exportDialog.passwordHint: Keep this password: you will need it to restore the backup.
exportDialog.passwordError: Use at least 12 characters and no more than 1024 UTF-8 bytes.

importDialog.title: Restore a backup
importDialog.description: Open an encrypted full backup, compare it with this library, and choose what to restore. Your current device identity and account session stay on this device.
importDialog.summary: {{events}} new events · {{rows}} records awaiting a choice · {{files}} files · {{plugins}} plugins · {{credentials}} credentials
importDialog.eventConflict: {{count}} conflicting event identities prevent this backup from being restored.
importDialog.bulkNotice: Batch choices include records, files, plugin data and local credentials. Current plugin code is kept; source-only plugins remain inactive. Choosing an absent credential removes its current value. You can revise individual choices below.
importDialog.managed: Preserved or handled by its dedicated restore rule.
importDialog.restricted: This data is reviewed through its dedicated file, plugin or credential controls.
importDialog.programNotice: Choose each plugin’s code and data separately. Backup code requires permission approval before it runs. Data-only restoration disables the plugin until you install compatible code.
importDialog.credentialNotice: Only presence is shown; secret values are never displayed. An absent or deleted choice removes the local credential. Locked synced values cannot be selected.
importDialog.checked: Record constraints passed. File bytes, target changes and plugin migrations will also be checked when you restore.
importDialog.constraintsFailed: Some selected records have incompatible references or values. Revise your choices before restoring.
importDialog.moreIssues: More issues exist. Resolve these choices and check again.
importDialog.confirmNotice: Restore the choices shown above? Selected values may replace current data. New backup events are retained; device identity and account session are preserved. After a successful restore, reload to use the restored library.
importDialog.success: Restored {{rows}} records, {{files}} files, {{plugins}} plugin namespaces and {{credentials}} credentials.
importDialog.cleanupPending: The restore committed. Temporary recovery files will be cleaned up at startup.
importDialog.reloadNotice: Writes are paused until reload so older screens cannot overwrite restored data.

logsRow.title: Log files

diagnostics.reportError: The report could not be sent. You can export the bundle and email it instead.

repair.title: Repair local projections
repair.description: Compare local data with the event log before repairing.
repair.consistent: Local projections match the event log. No repair is needed.
repair.preview: Differences: {{tables}} tables, {{live}} rows only in current data, {{replay}} rows only in replayed data.

localApi.title: Local API
localApi.enabled: Allow other AI apps to read ReadAware
localApi.description: Read books, annotations, reading progress and saved memories on this computer. Access is read-only and excludes stored credentials.
localApi.running: Running · Keep ReadAware open while connected.
localApi.rotated: Access token reset. Copy the new connection to reconnect your AI apps.
localApi.copied: Connection copied, including the access token. Share it only with AI apps you trust.
localApi.skillHint: Paste the installation prompt into your AI app. It will install the Skill from GitHub; provide the connection configuration separately.
localApi.installPrompt:
Install the ReadAware skill from this official source:
{{url}}

Fetch the SKILL.md file and install it as readaware/SKILL.md in the skills directory supported by your AI app. Use your app’s skill installation mechanism when available; ask for the destination only if it cannot be determined. Preserve any existing local customizations.

The Skill accesses ReadAware through its local read-only HTTP API. Install it without configuring MCP. Connection credentials are not included in this prompt; if READAWARE_API_URL and READAWARE_API_TOKEN are not already configured, ask me to provide the connection configuration from ReadAware → Settings → AI → Local API. Keep the token out of the Skill file and your replies. Once configured, check /v1/health from this computer and report whether the connection works. If the GitHub file cannot be fetched, report the failure instead of inventing its contents.
